verdict.rationale: Atlassian publishes a full REST v3 reference and an OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec with 433 paths. It also ships a vendor-generated Postman collection, which gives runnable examples, but only through an external tool. The reference pages themselves are static SSR documentation with no in-page console, so the interactive exploration part of the story is not delivered. Missing for 10: an interactive in-page API explorer or console, runnable examples inside the reference itself, and hands-on corroboration of using the Postman collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: its runnable affordance is the generated Postman collection, not an in-page console
alongside a vendor-generated Postman collection export
